svg.aria-label: Architecture: vendors POST to an API Gateway HTTP API; the receiver Lambda verifies the HMAC, writes the exact body to the S3 raw archive with a create-only put, then sends a pointer through SQS. The processor Lambda reads the body, normalises it and tokenises PII, applies a forward-only conditional update to DynamoDB state, writes the landing zone and records the idempotency ledger last; unparseable bodies go to quarantine and poison messages to the DLQ. A Step Functions pipeline compacts landing objects to Parquet, registers Glue partitions, runs data-quality SQL in Athena and reconciles against the ledger.
